digest.component_or_area: store initialization and migrations (ensure units registry)
propositions: Existing stores without .bridge_state/projects.json and bridge_project field on tickets cannot resolve projects on upgrade without migration, causing sync to stop

Two idempotent ensure units must seed the projects mapping (legacy_default + one projects entry from Backend.project) and conditionally add multi-project-bridge capability token, both check-then-act and writing zero ticket events
The seed unit must write only to .bridge_state/projects.json when absent and must verify no tree changes before commit to achieve zero-commit convergence on already-seeded stores

The capability-stamp unit must conditionally add multi-project-bridge to required_capabilities when mapping has multiple projects but store-compat.json lacks the token, never firing when seed creates single-project mapping

The migration must be observable via real git repos confirming zero ticket events written, idempotent re-runs return ok with unchanged branch SHA, and one-project vs multi-project stores differ in capability stamping
A two-project stamped store must still pass check_store_compat gate and all new ensure unit ids must be registered in REGISTRY_IDS and _registry() with test_registry_id_set_is_frozen literal updated
